description.value: The Reynolds Pub is part of the Reynolds Hotel, a boutique historic property built in 1941 in Lillooet, BC, extensively renovated to preserve a turn-of-the-century character with locally milled wood floors and antiques throughout. The pub features a sunny patio with mountain and canyon views, and serves a full restaurant menu alongside cold drinks. Lillooet lies at the confluence of the Fraser Canyon and the Sea-to-Sky Corridor, making this a well-positioned stop for cyclists travelling through the Interior.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names the business generically as 'Pub' with no address or phone, but the discovered URL leads to reynoldshotel.com, which confirms this is the Reynolds Pub — part of the historic Reynolds Hotel in Lillooet, BC. The website provides address (1237 Main Street, Lillooet, BC V0K 1V0), phone ((250) 256-4202), and confirms takeout is available ('For take-out please call...'). Bike parking, washrooms, and most amenities are not mentioned on the website; the patio is noted but no bike rack or visibility detail is given. URL discovery confidence was 'medium/uncertain', so the OSM node may or may not correspond precisely to the Reynolds Hotel building.
concerns: OSM name is the generic placeholder 'Pub' with no address, phone, or email tags. The actual business appears to be the Reynolds Restaurant & Pub at the Reynolds Hotel; the OSM record should be renamed.

URL was discovered with 'medium' confidence and flagged 'uncertain' — the OSM node coordinates should be verified against the hotel's civic address (1237 Main Street, Lillooet) to confirm the node is correctly placed.
Several website subpages (/amenities/, /fishing/, /comments/) returned Incapsula blocked responses, so the amenities page could not be reviewed for additional cyclist-relevant detail.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating pub and restaurant in Lillooet, BC with an active website and confirmed takeout service — a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Canyon or Sea-to-Sky routes.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering is also offered ('We cater at your place or ours, from small intimate dinners to large banquets and receptions'). The hotel's rooms offer Wi-Fi, but it is not confirmed as available to pub-only customers.
